answers.goal: I would love to represent athletes, specifically female athletes. The WNBA or PWHL would be my dream. As a woman, I would love to support women in the fastest growing industry as of now! I am also open to taking myself where the opportunities grow, whoever that may be :)
answers.drew: Growing up in LA i was always curious, but it wasn’t until I was removed from it at college that I realized it was a passion that ran deep. My favorite thing is working with people, especially people who create cool art. What better job than one that combines both?
answers.seeking: I really just want to make friends with like minded people, and start to create a network here in LA that once I graduated college I can come back to. I want community!
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is my dad. He pushes me to be better and to step outside of my comfort zone daily. He takes on tasks that seem huge and makes them look easy. “Let go of what you cannot control” my favorite quote of his. He is a pretty awesome person, and I hope to one day be as cool!!
